note: Briggs-Rauscher observer-band oscillator response surface (macro). Maps the nano reagent descriptors to the coefficients of a reduced Field-Koeroes-Noyes / Oregonator relaxation oscillator that the hook layer integrates: the stoichiometric factor f, the stiffness epsilon and threshold q, iodide regeneration/consumption, molecular-iodine production/removal, the triiodide-starch coupling, the oxidant/substrate reservoir depletion rate (which drives the eventual settle), and the physical seconds-per-tau time scale that sets the oscillation period. It also emits a response uncertainty sigma. NO cycle count, colour timeline, or phase schedule is an output here: whether the system oscillates, how many colourless->amber->deep-blue cycles occur, the period, and the final settled state all EMERGE from integrating the oscillator, and are graded against known Briggs-Rauscher behaviour only at run end. This compact response surface is illustrative rather than held-out metrology; its uncertainty is emitted and a wider trained oscillating-chemistry panel is tracked in ROADMAP.md.
